notes.title: A new patch is live!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello, travelers! [/h1]

Your reports have been instrumental, and we're grateful for your ongoing support. We've fixed a few things, and you can find them right here!

[b]ALL[/b]

Pinyin keyboard was modified to be easier to use.

[b]PC[/b]

Fixes to Mouse Cursor on the virtual keyboard.

[b]PS4[/b]

Game now works properly when the OS is in Turkish.

[b]Steam Deck[/b]

Game Resolution now matches the native resolution of the hardware.

 
Thank you all and have a nice day ✨

notes.title: A patch for your enchanted journey!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello, travelers![/h1]

We'd like to thank you for all your support since the release of [b][i]Chants of Sennaar! [/i][/b]

To make your adventure even better, we're now releasing a patch to improve the game's fluidity, translations and a few bugs!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42286095/3333c87a26822186f1aab9669009c7e677bd0535.png[/img]

[h2]Translation:[/h2]

- Modification of some translations on the bard-alchemist rosetta stone in the galleries.

[h2]Bug fix:[/h2]

- Writing an @ in a rune annotation no longer causes save corruption
- The framerate is now limited to 540 FPS max, resolving certain issues.
 
[h2]Improvements:[/h2]

- Esc can now be pressed to exit zoom views, dialogs, ghosts, processions, etc.
- The stairs in the silver mine are now made of iron, making them more visible.
- In the 2nd alchemists' lab, a graduated ruler with zoom view has been added.
- Radar can now be displayed by pressing left or right shift 
- New conditions to unlock the "I did it" achievement have been included.

notes.title: The Release Date has appeared!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello traveller![/h1]

Some time has passed since our last announcement, and the day has come to solve some of the mysteries surrounding Chants of Sennaar.

Embark on a captivating journey with ancient languages to decipher when [b]Chants of Sennaar releases September 5.[/b]

Your journey will soon begin, traveller, and it'll be up to you to discover the truth. Will you be able to reunite the Peoples of the Tower, who can no longer understand each other due to a terrible curse?

[b]Unveil mysteries behind the fragments of the past[/b]

[b]Explore and discover an enthralling world in a colorful, poetic setting[/b] inspired by the myth of Babel, where men have forgotten their past.
